Gaussian Filter

OpenVX Function Description

  • Computes a Gaussian filter over a window of the input image.

OpenVX Function Reference Page

  • https://www.khronos.org/registry/vx/specs/1.1/html/d6/d58/group__group__vision__function__gaussian__image.html

VXLIB API

  • VXLIB_gaussian_3x3_i8u_o8u : Input and output images are U8 format
  • VXLIB_gaussian_5x5_i8u_o8u : Input and output images are U8 format
